# Polygon Layer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A polygon per row when Position reads a geometry (holes and multi-polygons included); otherwise rows are vertices, grouped into polygons by an id, into rings by another (the first ring is the outline, the rest are holes), ordered by a third.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "polygon", "name": "polygon", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:lineWidthScale`, or read elsewhere as `ch('polygon/lineWidthScale')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Older projects

Projects saved before documents used operator classes. These convert to `polygon` when they open: `A5LayerOp`, `GeoJsonLayerOp`, `GeohashLayerOp`, `H3ClusterLayerOp`, `H3HexagonLayerOp`, `PolygonLayerOp`, `QuadkeyLayerOp`, `S2LayerOp`, `SolidPolygonLayerOp`.
